title: Virtual Compute: maximum resource count
content:
## Meaning — maximum resource count

Virtual Compute maximum resource count: Maximum provisioned resource count in one holding; integer.

## Tier values — maximum resource count

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — maximum resource count: 64.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — maximum resource count: 64.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — maximum resource count: 64.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — maximum resource count: 64.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — maximum resource count: 64.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — maximum resource count: 64.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for maximum resource count?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has maximum resource count of 64.

## Meaning — monthly amendment limit

Virtual Compute monthly amendment limit: Maximum accepted capacity amendments per holding in a UTC calendar month; integer.

## Tier values — monthly amendment limit

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — monthly amendment limit: 12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — monthly amendment limit: 12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — monthly amendment limit: 12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — monthly amendment limit: 12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — monthly amendment limit: 12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — monthly amendment limit: 12.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for maximum resource count?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has monthly amendment limit of 12.
